messages.subject: Difference results from different computers
parts:
When computing the item fit index for a model and dataset with numerous missing values, we observed discrepancies in results across different computers. On one computer, all indices for certain items were reported as NA using mirt version 1.4.1. 


In contrast, another computer, with mirt version 1.4.0, reported NA only for the z.infit values


Does anyone know the reasons for this, thanks in advance for any insights!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Difference results from different computers
parts:
You'd have to check the change logs for this one, but I believe this is related to an update where the package handled missing data more optimally for these fit statistics rather than just reporting NA placeholders.

Phil
